publication.edition: Pluhar English translation of Kritik der Urteilskraft (1790)

verification.verification_notes: Confirmed standard Pluhar translation of the 1790 Kritik der Urteilskraft. Used only for the received distinction between the mathematical and dynamical sublime - the mind's response when imagination is overwhelmed by magnitude or power - as philosophical context for scale and cadence, not for any claim about prose acoustics.

limitations: Kant's technical vocabulary (Erhabene, Einbildungskraft) is translation-sensitive; the dossier claims only the broad sublime distinction, not wording.

copyright.notes: 1790 original public domain; Pluhar translation copyrighted; analytical citation only; no passages reproduced.
